academicLevel: Final Year (4th Year / TY to Final Year)
phaseTitle: Industry Placement, Capstone Engineering & Career Launch
overview: Final year is the culmination of your 4-year CSE journey. The first semester (Sem 7) is dedicated to campus placements, off-campus hiring drives, and product company interviews. The second semester (Sem 8) focuses on the Major Capstone Engineering Project, production deployment, research publications, or full-time corporate internship.
keyGoals: Clear Tier-1/Tier-2 product & services company hiring pipelines (OA + Technical + Managerial + HR).
Complete a production-grade Major Capstone Engineering Project solving a real-world enterprise problem.
Master High-Level and Low-Level System Design (HLD & LLD).
Perform 10+ live technical mock interviews with peer feedback on live coding and problem explanation.
Achieve 85%+ on the 8-point CSE Graduation Readiness standard.

subjects.name: Distributed Systems & Cloud Architecture (System Design)
subjects.importance: Critical - Evaluated in Senior/Tier-1 SDE hiring rounds
coreConcepts: Consistency Models: Strong Consistency, Eventual Consistency, Linearizability
Distributed Consensus: Raft & Paxos algorithms, Split-brain problem
High-Level Design Problems: URL Shortener (Bitly), Rate Limiter (Token Bucket / Leaky Bucket), Distributed Cache, Notification Service, Video Streaming (YouTube/Netflix)
Database Sharding Strategies: Consistent Hashing, Range-based vs Hash-based partitioning
Microservices Observability: Distributed Tracing (Jaeger, OpenTelemetry), Centralized Logging (ELK Stack)

recommendedProjects.title: High-Throughput Distributed Rate Limiter & API Gateway with Redis Cluster
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Protect backend services from DDoS attacks, API abuse, and cascading failures under heavy traffic spikes.
keyFeatures: Token Bucket and Sliding Window Log rate-limiting algorithms implemented via Lua scripts in Redis to prevent race conditions.
Benchmarked with k6 load testing to sustain 25,000+ requests per second with <10ms P99 latency.
Dynamic IP & API key tiering (Free: 60 req/min, Premium: 1,000 req/min).
Prometheus exporter emitting live request rates, throttle ratios, and Grafana dashboard visualization.
learningOutcomes: Lua scripting in Redis for atomic operations

recommendedProjects.title: Enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Knowledge Base & Search Engine
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Companies have thousands of internal PDF documents, codebases, and compliance guidelines that generic LLMs cannot query without hallucinations.
keyFeatures: Document ingestion pipeline chunking PDFs, Markdown, and source code with recursive text splitters and semantic overlap.
Embedding generation stored in Vector DB with Cosine Similarity and HNSW indexing.
Hybrid Search (BM25 Keyword Search + Vector Dense Retrieval) with Cross-Encoder Reranking for high-precision retrieval.
Strict citation generation: outputs exact page number and source document alongside every answer.

recommendedProjects.title: Fault-Tolerant Distributed Key-Value Store with Raft Consensus
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Distributed storage nodes must remain consistent and accept writes even when individual servers crash or network partitions occur.
keyFeatures: Full Raft protocol implementation: Leader Election, Heartbeats, Log Replication, and Safety Invariants.
Persistent Write-Ahead Log (WAL) to disk preventing data loss on sudden node power outages.
Linearizable read/write operations verified using the Jepsen distributed testing framework.
Automatic cluster recovery and leader re-election in <300ms when the active leader fails.

recommendedProjects.title: Scalable Video Transcoding & Adaptive Bitrate Streaming Pipeline
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Users upload raw 4K/1080p MP4 videos that buffer continuously on mobile networks without adaptive resolution switching.
keyFeatures: Asynchronous worker pool (RabbitMQ) picking up raw video upload events.
FFmpeg transcoding pipeline generating HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) adaptive bitrate chunks (1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p).
Encrypted `.m3u8` playlist generation and segment distribution via CDN.
Custom video player with automatic network bandwidth detection and seamless quality switching.

recommendedProjects.title: Decentralized Escrow & Multi-Signature Smart Contract Payment Protocol
recommendedProjects.problemStatement: Freelancers and clients need a trustless, automated payment escrow that releases funds only upon verifiable milestone completion without third-party commission fees.
keyFeatures: Multi-signature (2-of-3) escrow smart contract holding funds securely until milestone delivery is signed off.
Automated arbitrator dispute resolution mechanism with timelocks.
ReentrancyGuard and complete OpenZeppelin security auditing preventing flash loan exploits.
Gas optimization reducing contract execution fees by 35% through struct packing.

round1.name: Online Assessment (OA)
round1.content: 2-3 DSA Coding Questions (Medium-Hard) + 15 Core CS MCQs (DBMS, OS, CN).
round1.passRule: 100% test cases passed with optimal time/space complexity.

round2.name: Technical Round 1 (Live Problem Solving)
round2.content: Live coding on CoderPad/Google Docs. Evaluator checks think-aloud explanation, dry-running, and edge case handling.

round3.name: Technical Round 2 (Resume Projects & Core CS)
round3.content: Deep architectural defense of your listed projects. Questions on Redis caching, DB schema, SQL joins, and concurrency.

round4.name: Managerial & HR Culture Fit Round
round4.content: STAR behavioral questions, conflict resolution, career goals, and company alignment.

monthlySprintRoadmap.focus: Daily Problem Solving & Company Specific Sheets
tasks: Solve 4 LeetCode problems daily (focus on Blind 75 and Striver SDE Sheet).
Revise DBMS SQL queries, OS Paging math, and CN TCP 3-way handshake.
Conduct 2 live mock interviews weekly with peers.
Defend listed projects: be prepared to draw system architecture diagrams on a whiteboard.
Practice STAR behavioral questions for HR rounds.
Attend on-campus interview drives and apply to off-campus referrals.
Finalize Major Capstone Project problem statement with faculty guide.
Design database schema, API contracts, and high-level architecture diagram.
Build MVP core engine (e.g. Distributed Rate Limiter / Raft KV Store / Enterprise RAG).

monthlySprintRoadmap.focus: Final Project Deployment, Report & Career Onboarding
tasks: Complete project documentation, test suite, and live cloud deployment.
Prepare final project PPT presentation and defend in final university viva.
Complete onboarding prerequisites for your full-time Software Engineer job role.
